title: Senior Technical Manager
description:
* Job Description:Role: Senior Technical ManagerLocation: Indore and PuneExperience: 12-18 yearsKey Skills: Microsoft Azure, .NET Core, Microservices Architecture, Cloud Transformation, Engineering Leadership, Account Management, CI/CD & DevOps, Stakeholder ManagementJob Description:As a Senior Technical Manager, you will provide strategic technology leadership, account management, and engineering oversight across enterprise cloud transformation initiatives. You will drive cloud-native development and modernization on Microsoft Azure and .NET platforms while leading cross-functional teams, cultivating client relationships, and ensuring delivery excellence.What will your role look like **Architect, design, and deliver enterprise-scale applications built on Microsoft Azure and .NET technologies.** Drive cloud modernization, migration, and adoption using Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Storage, API Management, and DevOps. **Manage multiple client engagements to ensure high customer satisfaction, delivery excellence, and achievement of business objectives.** Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, delivering strategic technical recommendations and roadmap guidance. **Oversee technical governance, architecture reviews, solution design, risk management, and engineering best practices.** Lead, mentor, and foster growth for cross-functional teams comprising architects, developers, QA engineers, and DevOps professionals. **Partner with sales and leadership teams on estimations, solutioning, proposals, and business growth initiatives.** Identify account expansion opportunities across cloud modernization, digital transformation, and AI-enabled solutions. **Establish and track delivery KPIs, project health, resource utilization, and customer satisfaction metrics.** Promote a workplace culture centered on innovation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.Why you will love this role **Opportunity to spearhead impactful digital transformation and cloud modernization projects for enterprise clients.** Leadership scope over large-scale, cross-functional engineering teams of 20+ professionals. **Direct visibility and engagement with executive client stakeholders and strategic decision-makers.** A collaborative, innovation-driven culture that encourages modern engineering practices and exposure to emerging technologies like AI.We would like you to bring along **12 to 18 years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and technology leadership.** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. **Strong technical expertise in Microsoft Azure, .NET Core/.NET 6+, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST Web APIs, and Microservices architecture.** Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, SQL Server, and cloud-native design patterns. **Proven track record leading engineering teams of 20+ members across multiple concurrent projects.** Demonstrated account management experience with executive stakeholders and a history of driving strategic account growth. **Exceptional verbal, written, and executive presentation skills combined with strong business acumen.** Azure certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, Administrator) and exposure to AI-enabled tools or OpenAI integrations are highly desirable.About usInfoBeans, founded in 2000, is a publicly listed company on the NSE & BSE in India, specializing in AI-first software development and implementation for enterprise clients to solve complex business challenges. We strive to deliver value-accretive services over the long term, working as an extension of our clients’ teams.We are 1700+ members across our offices in India, the USA, Europe, and the Middle East. We believe that InfoBeans is our team’s second home and work hard every day to build a culture that fosters collaboration and excellence. InfoBeans Foundation, our CSR arm, helps underprivileged sections of society become employable through our free one-year training programs.Creating WOW! is not just a tagline for us; it’s our religion!

Pay: ₹2,800,000.00 - ₹5,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person
